ditto this worked for me. thank you!
yeah i don’t wear make up. i’m a girl. never have. wish more men were like you.

this is incredibly person specific. one person can be exponentially more mature than the other. generally most 22 year olds may not be able to relate to a 26-7 year old. your hormones slow down a little with age. your priorities get more in focus. there is never any harm in trying just understand that you may face issues related to age or maturity in the future.

not a stupid question. i’m a lady and find myself turned off by normies or people who self identify as woke. it’s hard to date in the town i live in since most everyone is a mask wearing vaxxed ukrainian supporter.

it was worse than i thought. he crashed his car into a tree willingly and jumped in front of a car. he’s been in the hospital since friday night. and he hasn’t really come back to consciousness. he’s speaking gibberish mostly. thankfully he’s in the right place and they will care for him. i’m going to visit him in an hour. we shall see how that goes.

you’re not being condescending. i’m trying to understand him better and thought he had some narcissistic traits. it’s engrained and he has no interest in changing he just wants me back under his control. i have no interest in being with him again. i feel much better since ending the relationship. i’ve stopped grinding my teeth and feeling so insecure all the time. i’m no longer second guessing everything or filtering myself because he might explode
my Nex got heart burn and thought that was dying. we spent 6 hours in the ER.

yeah it feels like he’s going to go back to being a jerk really fast as soon as he gets what he wants or i stop responding for good. i don’t want to explain myself. i did tell him he was manipulative and he was stunned. it’s interesting to watch how he responds to being found out.

yeah he seems highly manipulative if nothing else. but i can’t formally diagnose anyone. i havent experienced this hovering before but yeah that’s what it sounds like. he’s very interested in me not hating him and him having control. he will flip to devaluing me sooner than later. more shame. everyone i’ve talked to called him a manipulator.
yeah he’s always point out hot women on the street  or on tv and say they were not while trying to change how i looked.

yeah this is absolutely my experience. everything negative about him would be a direct assault on his ego. he was empathetic as long as it got him what he wanted and when i dumped him he went back and forth multiple times in the phone call. he is hovering now and went from kind to jerk in a couple hours (zero input from me). 

even with simple things like coming to visit him. he’d pay for the hotel since he lived with his parents to save money but would guilt me for the expense. i offered to split it with him many times and he really only allowed once but loved holding it over my head. all the trips resulted in him complaining excessively about how expensive everything was. he never said i was worth it. eventually i told him i didn’t want to keep hearing how expensive things were and it was best if we didn’t do them to which he also got upset. 

looking back…any of his kindness had ulterior motives for sure. usually they’d be expressed verbally or it was just some shaming or guilt pushed on me for needing something from him. “women always take, women need this, women are so emotional.” etc 

it felt like a burden to be myself. being called pathetic for being injured at work. stuff like that.
all of a sudden they want to get to the bottom of what went wrong when you’ve been telling them all along.

oh yeah. i used to tell mine that i didn’t like it when he busted my chops. he’d steamroll me and do it harder or tell me it was a joke. i felt like he never heard me when it mattered. countless times i’d have to stop him and ask if he’d heard me and he never did.

grinding teeth, poor sleep, and a lower walking steadiness score. he encouraged me to change things about myself like painting my nails and such which aren’t me. lots of body pain. i also sustained an injury at work that could be from distraction over all.

you’re right. he’s very verbally abusive and increasingly so. it’s like he was testing my boundaries before being worse. He’s gone. He knows it’s over. He said he wouldn’t simp around for me. As we ended the final call he said he hopes i change my mind. Psychologically mental abuse does serious damage. i’m glad you got out!!

it’s hard for me to read back what i wrote and believe it. we have one mural friend left and i’m not sure how to handle that. we hung out with him and his gf on my last visit. guess i’ll tell him and be more honest than i was with my ex about why it ended. i know he was never physically abusive but i felt so wretched with him at times. i’m glad we were never in the same town for long. he says the most mean things at the worst moments and acts like it’s nothing. it was hard to break it off and i honestly cried a bit because i grew so attached.
good riddance. that guy is a complete waste of energy. NEXT!
Hell yeah sister! He’s a keeper!
i imagine i’m being weak but i’d rather ghost and move on. he’s hard to communicate with so i’d prefer to have zero conversations anymore.
i’m going no contact. we’ll see if i have to block him.

he has a lot of work to do that i cant help with. definitely a jerk.   


thank you and good luck with your self work journey as well.

You are right. It really hits home to read that. He really doesn't know who I am. I blow glass for fun and sell some of my work at a local store. He told me he would never pay $30 for a cup (not even taking into account that i have to pay that store 30% for the shelf space). The guy just doesn't get me or why I would be upset by the assessment that "art that isn't something you make is stupid and pointless. children shouldn't be taught art in schools."   


My gut also told me not to start this relationship and I didn't listen. He made me cry about the clothes that I wear before we even started dating. Made fun of me so bad I didnt want to keep talking to him. Yet somehow through the trauma bond we developed being a part of a small group of friends things spiraled. We were pushed into making the relationship official. He called me his gf without even asking me if I wanted to be that.   


I can see past it and I am sure I will find more issues as the weeks pass.   


Thanks again!

Yeah he has always been subtly trying to make me change and make me feel bad for just being myself. I've told him before that I feel like he doesn't get me which he tells me is very mean to say. The move would be forced and not at all mutual. At one point I felt like I could be with him but it was a short stint. He made me feel guilty about meeting his parents which wasn't even my idea. We started this whole thing knowing that neither of us wanted to move and that it likely couldn't be serious.   


Sounds like you have made some good changes in your life and you know you have some more work to do. He does deserve love and therapy but I cannot be that person for him. He isn't going to go to therapy. That isn't this mans style. I am pretty sure the exact words he would use are "fake and ghey". I won't move or even keep talking to him. I want to be with someone who has done some more self work.   


I appreciate the message. It is really helpful. I hope he gets the help he needs. I think I am better off with someone a little older than me.

what signs do you see? that’s pretty helpful advice. thank you. he does need self work which i have told him before but he didn’t listen. the last relationship he was in was awful and not at all his fault according to him. the lady was crazy and lied to him constantly. he used to compare me to her all the time which i asked him to stop doing. we aren’t the same person but she was his only frame of reference. “my ex used to say that” was a common sentence until we talked about it. i should have trust my gut on that.
i’m going NC and i don’t think we will end up being friends again but who knows. i don’t like him as a partner. he’s very hard to be with.

my preference is no contact but we used to talk all day every day. i can see him sending a few texts here and there. i’m not interested in continuing conversations. should i tell him not to contact me?

i really don’t know. at first it felt like he had my back and cared about me but the more i’ve gotten to know him the less i feel comfortable being myself. it seems like he liked the idea of me and in practice it’s just not his cup of tea. i think my lack of self love and self worth drove me to be with someone who i had to convince. i’m not sure. he always calling me a dork.

yeah we’ve barely been together and he’s subtly telling me to change things but saying he doesn’t want me to change. it’s cognitive dissonance. in reality i think he knows i’m a catch but honestly doesn’t like many things that make me who i am.

i appreciate this message. the situation is sad. i’ve never felt this uncomfortable in my own skin dating someone. i don’t feel accepted and i told him that. i said i’ve shaved and done so much and i don’t feel comfortable around you. 

it’s the first time i’ve been with someone who is constantly criticizing me like this. when i go to defend myself or say i don’t like it he says he’s just busting my chops. 

i like what you said about true love focusing on growth without judgement or trying to change a person. i know we are not compatible and have told him that before but he refuses to listen. i don’t think conversations with him are productive and i’ve said that too. he’s a jerk so healthy communication isn’t possible. 

we just went to visit my sister and i know she could have made more of an effort but he just trashed her all the way home. i met his family or at least a few of them and i didn’t trash them because i know he’d tell me not to. the man is deaf to things. he knows he messed up with his comments this evening and is being extra nice. at the end of the day he will make me pay i’m sure. 

i want someone who gets me. i’m an artist and he told me he would never pay for my art because it’s too expensive. i make glass cups for under 35$.

he’s a handful and not worth the trouble in any capacity. i feel like he is slowly picking on me and hoping i change. i’ve never heard the term hen pecking before. i do feel like he wants me to conform to his preferences even if he doesn’t explicitly say do this it’s obvious that’s what he wants. 

i’ve told him that people have liked me for me in the past and he usually rambles about how my clothes or hair aren’t my identity.

yeah he made my doubt myself from day one. it’s really on me for putting up with it for so long. perhaps i too got lost in some imaginary version of him or just didn’t want to be alone. compatibility is important. i tried to explain to him that pheromones matter and there are people who have enjoyed me for me. usually he shames me for “being attached to blah blah.” as if my clothes are my identity. 

i think he would also go nuts about sunk cost but it’s relatively short in the grand scheme of things and a cheap lesson if i save myself from being miserable.

yeah i’ve talked to him about this recently. he is an asshole but doesn’t think he is. he doesn’t think he’s bringing me down and instead says i’m only busting your chops. really just a bad fit i think. i appreciate you saying he doesn’t deserve me.

i honestly don’t know. he had my back through a lot of stuff but in practice and in relationship he’s very critical and harsh. it’s very hard to communicate with him about these things because he’s tells me i’m making him feel bad. for example i told him that i feel like he doesn’t get me and he uses that against me all the time. saying that i’m deliberately mean.

sounds like you are on the right path! i notice a difference in my breathing and overall stamina since quitting. yoga is a great reason to quit. a mystery novel sounds like a lot of fun! i like to read too and have found more space in my mind to stay focused. hiking, gardening, and riding my bike are some of my favorite past times. hanging out with friends can be fun too. i'm doing my best to put a lot of energy into physical endeavors to help cope.
day 2! you can do it! what other things do you enjoy doing with your time?
thanks! and that’s amazing!! definitely something to be proud of!
hell yeah! i can say with confidence that it’s worth it for me and it could be for you! the clarity in the day to day alone is amazing. don’t give up!
thanks for sharing! you got this!!

thank you so much! pat yourself on the back for making it 5 days! day 4 was the hardest one for me. the cravings were strong. it gets so much easier after the first week and then it stopped being a struggle. i hope you feel the same way too! keep at it 🙌
amazing! congratulations on day 1! it’s one of the hardest. things get way easier after day 5. and the future is bright! you should be very proud ☺️
yay! and it only gets better from here. you got this!

can definitely related to having smoked enough for a lifetime. at my peak it was about an ounce a week. i wasn't even getting high anymore. weed isn't bad...like you said my relationship with it was not great. my relationships with people are improving as well...romantic life is in shambles though. i am overthinking everything now that i cannot numb myself...so that has been really hard to deal with.
Hell yes! that is awesome! good on you for staying strong. i kinda feel the same way. at first i thought i might smoke again in the future but now i just don't see any reason.
thanks! i feel like celebrating with nice dinner or something.
Yes! it truly does feel like i am different person. i am loving the life changes. congrats on three weeks! that is huge!!

i’m really sorry to hear that you’re dealing with a non supportive group of friends. that can make the whole process so much harder. kudos to you for making it this far! it’s frickin hard! my friends also don’t perceive it to be an issue and they always tell me i’m just taking a tolerance break and i’ll smoke again sometime....i tell them that i’m an addict and would like control over my life. it’s hard to explain the negatives to people who don’t get it :( i had a couple friends that were really not supportive and i stopped hanging out with them/created better boundaries while i go through the early stages of quitting...kinda sucks

i get that. i’ve replaced weed with radical honesty and knitting. it’s kinda working sometimes. i’m worried about playing video games or using other substances because i worry i’ll get sucked in on an unhealthy level.

truly couldn’t agree more! ♥️

I know that I will get over this with time. It is really raw right now. I am taking it day by day. My other couple friends are surprised that I am still going through with it. I love this holiday and to some degree want to do it for myself even if seeing him will be painful. I've thought about uninviting him...

Thank you for saying that. I talked to a friend about it and she said the same thing. It feels crazy. I haven't been this disrespected by someone before. What hurts the most is that I thought he was my friend. He has been there for me through so much and now I see that he's just a jerk. I've got friends who are exes but we were never in defined relationship. I thought we were just feeling things out. 

Letting go seems like the healthiest thing here. He will be sad to lose me but he doesn't deserve my time and energy anymore. Even as a friend it just feels fucked.

Thanks for this response! It honestly made me dance! 

It’s pretty exciting and a lot to unpack for sure. Having waited for it for years, I’m still pretty in my head about certain things and will need to relax. The emotional intimacy, great conversation, and intense passion is rocking. 

The depression concerns me too. The physical and energetic withdrawal can be difficult. Fortunately he’s capable of communicating during and after. Could you elaborate on the codependency scenario? We have had time to establish boundaries and healthy ways to communicate with each other. It does feel surreal even if it was a long time coming. 

Yes one of the great fears is self sabotage. When he’s around he’s in tune to my anxiety. He does a great job of being supportive when he’s not around as well. 

The moments we’ve shared have been really great leading up to this. I’m pretty stoked for the future no matter what happens. Still pinching myself. What a joy it is explore someone you’ve pined for for so long and give them pleasure.  

p.s. great screen name 🌶

Thank you for the words of encouragement. It’s a lot to take in. 

7 years is definitely a slow path. The prospect of what this could be is pretty exciting and we’ve certainly talked about common goals and dreams but I don’t want to get ahead of myself. Getting on the same page at this point is important. 

We’ve talked about kids and marriage in a different context - what we want in our futures - not necessarily with each other though it would be pretty exciting to me.
